description: Phase 09 Prompt 30 — memory quality review. A read-only, advisory evaluation of proposed long-term memory candidates (memory_update_candidates, status='proposed') for duplicate / stale / conflicting status against the accepted memory corpus. Duplicate = the candidate's statement (hashed) matches an accepted memory item (or another candidate); stale = it matches a superseded item (restates outdated memory); conflicting = the candidate carries the deterministic conflict reason code (T3_CONFLICT_DETECTED). Flagged candidates are surfaced for human review — the surface NEVER merges, deletes, or accepts memory, and makes no determination. Persists metadata-only run receipts to the reserved V38 second_brain_memory_quality_review_runs table (read-only by default). No raw memory statement text is persisted or emitted — only SHA256 statement hashes, counts, and review vocabulary.
